title.en: Kon'yaku Hakisareta no ni Moto Kon'yakusha no Kekkonshiki ni Shoutaisaremashita. Kotowarenai no de Ani no Yuujin ni Doukou shite Moraimasu
Konyaku Hakisareta "Kuuki" na Watashi, Nariagari no Danna-sama ni Totsugimashita
Imouto ni Konyakusha wo Toraretara Mishiranu Koushaku-sama ni Kyuukonsaremashita
Kon'yaku Haki o Neratte Kioku Soushitsu no Furi o Shitara, Sokkenai Taido datta Kon'yakusha ga "Kioku o Ushinau Mae no Kimi wa, Ore ni Betabore datta" to Iu, Tondemonai Uso o Tsuki Hajimeta
Kakure Saijo wa Zenzen Megenai: Gibo to Gimai ni Ie o Oidasareta no de Kon'yaku Haki shite Moraou to Omottara, Shinshi Datta Kon'yakusha ga Hageshiku Dekiai shite kuru you ni narimashita!?
Gishi no Kawari ni, Yomei Ichinen to Iwareru Koushaku Shisoku-sama to Konyaku suru Koto ni Narimashita
Konyaku Hakisareta Gakeppuchi Reijou wa, Teikoku no Sumeragi Otouto Denka to Musubareru
Tsuihousareta Seijo wa, Suterareta Mori de Wakeari Biseinen wo Hirou
"24-ten" to Konyaku Hakisareta Reijou wa, Ringoku no Outaishi ni Kanpeki na Hanayome to Aisareru
Do Majime Jijo no Kon'yaku Soudou! ~Mukuchina Kishi-dan fuku Danchou ni Jitsuwa Betabore Saretemashita~
Okazari Ouhi ni Nattanode, Kossori Hataraki ni Deru Koto ni Shimashita ~Usagi ga Iru node Hitorine mo Sabishiku Arimasen!~
Kanjou wo Korosu no wo Yameta Moto Koushaku Reijou wa, Minna ni Dekiaisareteimasu!
Denka, Anata ga Suteta Onna ga Honmono no Seijo desu
Ohitorisama ni wa Naremashita no de. Konyakusha Houchi-chuu!
Hakushaku-ke wo Mamoru Tame ni Toriaezu Konyakushimashita - Neet no Reijou wa Shuubun wo Harashi Ijiwaru na Koushaku-ke ni Taikou suru Tame Ichikabachika no Konyaku wo Ketsuden suru
Aru Hi, Mukuchi na Konyakusha no Kanjou ga Wakaru you ni narimashita
